notes.title: Dynopunk Anniversary Prizes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/a26c581cc322529ef9397b3b084451f648f5ccdd.png[/img]

This summer, we are excited to celebrate Dynopunk's first anniversary! It has been a year since the game released and charmed us all with its hilarious antics and ironic adventures… And what a fun journey it was! We would like to thank you, the players, for your support and enthusiasm—your feedback and suggestions proved invaluable during the game’s development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/81e06b4200684fc2eb1d3c6843ebe9233a54ffd4.png[/img] As a small gift, we have prepared Steam collectibles for the community to enjoy: cards, badges, wallpapers, and emoticons! Decorate your profile and express yourself in chat with your favorite Dynopunk characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/a26c581cc322529ef9397b3b084451f648f5ccdd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/849bbac2fee71e12a54efa6b485eaecdd84daa1e.png[/img] [b]Dynopunk’s Achievements[/b]

Many interesting things have happened to our game since its launch:
[list][*] The game won the hearts of many players and accumulated numerous positive reviews. Right now, Dynopunk sports a "Very Positive" score on Steam, and we would like to highlight some of our favorite reviews:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/75cdf7c1ba6281fa3da4c3e05dfe961c179099e7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/d9bfdffcd11fe2dc102d9ee213913c60bccb4e4e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/aa77059fca089b54ba0f13d67949310ac37a854b.jpg[/img]

[*] The game won multiple awards, including:
- BIG Festival, Narrative Finalist;
- NYX Game Awards Year 2022, Gold Winner.
[*] We have released a special expansion, featuring the in-game soundtrack composed by Josh Lim.[/list]
Thank you, everybody!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/a26c581cc322529ef9397b3b084451f648f5ccdd.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more project news on [url=https://discord.gg/B3JWMwKmqz]our official Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Patch 1.03 is live!
notes.content:
Hey there, dynos! 

We're still looking through your feedback and bug reports on Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/MpJPKq4yyN]our Discord server.[/url] And here's another patch for you all, with a few more fixes for the issues you've reported.

Here's the list of changes in the Patch 1.03:
[olist]
[*] Fixed the bug where players would ruin their save files by abruptly leaving the final scenes of the game. The fix works retroactively, so if you've encountered this issue, you may now finish your game!
[*] Fixed the issue with starting a New Game from Day 1 after the first play through.
[*] Fixed the bug with the basketball getting stuck at a party.
[/olist]
That's all, folks! Hope those fixes will help you have a better experience playing [b]Dynopunk[/b]!

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/MpJPKq4yyN]Discord server[/url], it is the best place to discuss the game, chat with the developers and stay updated on the game's news!

Have fun in the Synth-City!

notes.title: Patch 1.02 is live!
notes.content:
Hello, dynos! 

Over the last couple of days, we've been looking through your feedback and bug reports on Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/MpJPKq4yyN]our Discord server.[/url] Thank you all so much for your patience in the wait for the bug fixes!

Here's the cumulative list of changes in the Patch 1.02:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a number of visual bugs, like disappearance of repair items and such.
[*] Fixed a number of situations where reloading the game would lead to the softlock of the save.
[*] NO MORE DUPING! [i](YAY or NAY?)[/i]
[*] Bon would get so confused if you'd offer him a cup of soda instead of your regular old tea or coffee, that he would break the dialogue box! Come on, dude! First you shatter the window, now you shatter the 4th wall???
[*] Fixed a number of localization issues.
[*] The microwave timer bug at the auction has been fixed.
[*] Justin would still talk during the party, even though he was not invited and technically isn't even there :/
[*] Fixed the reloading bug for Day 21!
[*] New visuals for sodas had been added! 
[*] Fixed the bug with the Time Machine cabin in the New Game +
[/olist]
And that's about it! Hope those fixes will help you have a better experience playing [b]Dynopunk[/b]!

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/MpJPKq4yyN]Discord server[/url], it is the best place to discuss the game, chat with the developers and stay updated on the game's news!

We hear you guys, and appreciate your support and feedback very, very much! Take care and have fun in the Synth-City!

notes.title: Updated Demo Version of Dynopunk at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Tomato Fantasy Games[/b] studio is pleased to announce that the [b]Dynopunk [/b]demo received an update today as part of the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] event!

[b]Dynopunk [/b]is an ironic adventure with cyberpunk aesthetics, set in a world where humans have been replaced by dinosaurs. Become a top-notch repair shop mechanic: fix gadgets, have heart-to-heart talks and offer drinks to your customers — everything to fulfill your ultimate dream.

Introducing a new trailer that will showcase the world and the many individual character stories of [b]Dynopunk[/b] in greater detail!

[previewyoutube=jmmsLw0iAwQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The new title by [b]Tomato Fantasy Games[/b] indie studio will take you to an alternative world of the future where dinosaurs have settled the Earth instead of people and are now living in high-tech megalopolises.

The [b]Dynopunk[/b] demo offers a chance to live a full day as a resident of a futuristic city, but there is a catch — you will now have to deal with having much shorter arms!

Every dinosaur in the bustling [i]Synth-City[/i] has their own story, goals and dreams. It is his ultimate ambition that beckons Chris, the game's protagonist, toward neon metropolitan lights. While it may initially seem that he is really close to achieving his goal of acquiring a repair shop and becoming a first-class repair master, the best technician in town... 

But the moment you start playing, you will quickly realize that not everything is as it looks. Chris is the last living T. rex after all, so he dreams of building a time machine in order to go back to the past and find his true love. Whether he succeeds or not depends entirely on the [b]quality[/b] of your repair work and customer communication skills.

The demo features:
[list]
[*] One in-game day of running your own workshop where you can learn the secrets of equipment repairs. Disassemble and replace parts by carving out the required chips. You can even play a prank on your customers if you wish... or have an ulterior motive. Just be ready to face the consequences!
[*] Great opportunity to exchange pleasantries with a quirky assistant — a talking printer that enjoys teasing Chris about his little arms and likes to give questionable business advice.
[*] Drink serving simulator, which affects not only the customers' mood but also the size of your tip.
[*] Original, 80s-inspired Lo-fi soundtrack! Pour yourself a cup of hot tea, then sit back, relax and get immersed in the story.
[*] Many interesting characters that will pay a visit to your repair shop. Each of them comes with unique traits, dreams and a personal story that can be influenced by player choice.
[*] Dialogues full of irony, jokes, references and Easter eggs to cheer you up!
[*] Pixelated graphics inspired by 1990s retro gaming.
[/list]
See you in [b]Synth-City[/b]!
